🔹 new version of load - save

notes.title: ☃️Survey results finally available!🕵
notes.content:
[h1]☃️Hey snow fans!❄️🌨️[/h1] 

[h3]For the past few months, you have helped us by completing the survey for Snow Plowing.

We are extremely grateful to you! We must admit that the results were surprising to us - but only in the positive sense. 227 responses to such a detailed survey and your activity in the open questions - we are very impressed by your activity and helpːsteamhappyː

THANK YOU❗️❤️So what do you say about starting the analysis? Let's go❗️

[/h3]

[h1]1.Game system📶[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/05dccff65593e32d2ceaefe8ff0ae12f4f70df09.jpg[/img]
[b]The majority of players are against solutions that can hinder gameplay. This is why we choose not to introduce the possibility of carrying a single tool⛔️
[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/c49c8499de771d63a05ccc7ffc51e0cf1a9a0708.jpg[/img]
[b]By the same token, we are abandoning thieves in gameplay⛔️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/2ff65995f5389e24c5b0199c3194d11be20be47e.jpg[/img]
[b]As for the issue of owning your own home - we will consider introducing this. The feedback is rather neutral/positive✅[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/dcebdf1c59f18847775dcfa1b69cdf01dce8111a.jpg[/img]
[b]The next question was open for your completion (question related to the previous). We are inserting a link for you to view the answers for yourself:[/b]
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/17fOmyy_D4LhkBwIxdZ3wqFl59PhHGJsXl_KtZktMuis/viewanalytics
[b]According to our analysis, what you expect most in home is: a resting place, the possibility to personalise your home, food storage with tools and vehicles, but also new mechanics like a weather forecast on TV. 

This sounds very cool :) Before the introduction, we will analyse all the answers again to select the most important aspects.[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/11c6742058aba699e733b33b59dc40624da2f0d4.jpg[/img]
[b]The idea of running a company caused mixed feelings. Some people are in favour, some are not. We are sceptical about this solution and will probably not introduce it ⚠️[/b]

As a curiosity, you can check your answers about running a business:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/17fOmyy_D4LhkBwIxdZ3wqFl59PhHGJsXl_KtZktMuis/viewanalytics


[h1]⬇️⛷️🏂[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/fa7aa39e5d4466327427ad2cfcbae52a5db51ae5.jpg[/img]
[b]In the ski resort question, on the other hand, you were very much in agreement - the majority of you are in favour of the idea. In that case, we can confirm to you - we will introduce such an update!🎿✅[/b]

[h1]⬇️👽[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/150d62812ab6a7354d1fc7d992720ceed788a235.jpg[/img]
You are also rather in favour of introducing more plot threads. Therefore - this is what we will do!👾🛰️✅

[h1]2.🛠️New items to buy📞[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/42f9f3be268da03f2b4cc39f2c53ccf874912788.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/661743a7738692e2a70ec85718d88715c01dc0b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/9e3b8f522b5482d471bb841bec00cbe2bbe8deea.jpg[/img]

[b]In the tools section - we'll definitely let go of the flamethrower, but probably also the camera or radio - it's not a priority for you⛔️

We will definitely introduce a salt and sand spreader! So will navigation and mobile phone✅

The other things we are in favour of, while we prioritise the things that are most on the very important/important
[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/cea0c7bbcbc971c7cf10382827142c6e62d607eb.jpg[/img]
[b]You are most in favour of new vehicles and new ploughs. Then that's the direction we'll be going in!✅

More details can be found in the open questions at the link I pasted above.
[/b]

[h1]3.🚞Vehicles🚗[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/a70ef57b80ba27411ff4c554b18fac348d46a5ee.jpg[/img]
[b]You care most about manoeuvrability and vehicle suspension. I include the question as a curiosity because after the last January update the driving has been fixed!🔧 We will think about other things like colour change and changing speed.

There are also open questions in the survey, which I recommend reading. You point out, among other things, support for controllers and steering wheels - we promise to introduce this in next months!🕹️
[/b]

[h1]⬇️🚜🛤️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/ce185763979d36fe17ec6ad6ad106802eda32e37.jpg[/img]
[b]And here's a surprise for you - the trailer will be introduced for an update in March![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/755422337942d7c5be1057858b5495f3a708eb62.jpg[/img]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/946b3011be826b34e37f3223b2662b206f6c1cbb.jpg[/img]
[b]Collision of vehicles and refueling vehicles is unlikely to be introduced⛔️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/c11b665c22f5607271e9c2db2f506191c11add8c.jpg[/img]
[b]We will consider the introduction of expensive teleports to reduce the time it takes to move between locations. We are keen not to knock you out of the immersion experience, so either expensive💸 or not at all⛔️

The rest of your opinions from the open question are in the survey. You focus on improving driving physics (this has already been fixed), increasing warning lights, more vehicles and customisation, also criticising teleports and wanting to introduce GPS.
[/b]

[h1]4.🔩Technicalities⚙️ [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/cf0949db70cb94805a893588a490d8c7df2739c1.jpg[/img]
[b]You are in favour of introducing multiple save slots, but also of adding achivements. In addition, you want to fix the appearance of snow, which is still sometimes buggy🛠️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/8b171e34ec517a02cdc23a4953ab28e3336d6ebc.jpg[/img]
[b]In addition, we intend to introduce the possibility of using a pad, as I mentioned earlier. You also care about further improving performance↗️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/3d78922626140a261e9d8f8c978444cb53fea502.jpg[/img]
[b]In the last section of the open-text question you focus on:
- the possibility of viewing the aurora borealis, constellations
- additional activities such as rescuing cars from snowdrifts, clearing snow from railway tracks
- different types of snow such as powder, ice and slush
- more NPCs, better sound
- possibility to work with AI, more NPCs

- more artefacts, finds, easter-eggs

Thank you for your suggestions - this is the part that caught our eye. Read the rest for yourself! We are, of course, analysing everything you have reported to us.
[/b]

[h1]❤️👩‍🚀Now we're getting to work - and preparing a new update for you. Thank you again - YOU ARE OUR HEROES!👨‍🚀❤️[/h1]



❗️Remember - Snow Plowing is still in Early Access. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports❗️

Do it via discord 📢[/b]

2. Santa will appear on 25 December. You will be able to talk to him until 31 December to collect your prize.
3. Gifts appear on the map - they are marked with a gift. You may occasionally have to dig them out by using a shovel!
4. Is it possible to collect presents on, say, 31 December and meet Santa then?
Of course, yes. Then there will simply be 6 gifts marked, which you can collect in one go. Then you will also be able to talk to Santa right away.

For now we are not revealing, but in our opinion the gift will be cool!

No. We know that you may have less time through the festive period, so this is not counted in any way. All that matters is that you complete the event by 31 December.

notes.title: Autosave and major optimization progress update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3mE0YRT3FXs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]☃️Hey snow fans!❄️🌨️[/h1] 

[h2]We would like to present you an optimisation update with the introduction of auto-save! In addition, we have a few more features, including direct contact with us through the gameːthebuilderː ːladyengineerː Without further delays, let's start❗️[/h2]

[h1]🖥️Optimalisation💻 [/h1]
[b] 1. Changing from DirectX12 to DirectX11👨‍💻 [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/298eaa16319b3dafaebda45923a7cb17c068c08c.jpg[/img]
[b]Changing to DirectX11 allows for a drastic reduction of stuttering in Snow Plowing. There should no longer be random FPS drops when moving/driving a car (after changing DirectX12 to DirextX11, remember to click save and do a game relog!)
[/b]
[b]2. Snow track accuracy[/b]⛄️🌨️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/9170fe5eb45eb7d71258f2561f2bfa4b03c0c51d.jpg[/img]
[b]You can change this value from 1 to 20. 1 - the most frequent, default refresh rate, 20 - the rarest. The closer you get to 20, the more FPS you will have. My advice is to change from 1 to 4 to start with and see the difference in FPS (we tested it on a couple of computers and the difference is big, sometimes as much as 50% more FPS with options closer to 20), then calibrate the frequency to your preference. (Note - at option 20, due to the infrequent refresh rate, the snow may look a little strange, while the gameplay will be smoothest)[/b]

[h1]💾Autosave🎮[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/7b5340160e34f1b42fb0225e847b3ce0aee82771.jpg[/img]
[b]The game will save itself every time you leave the property or leave the road which is a snow plowing mission. The option will be indicated by the autosave sign at the top of the screen.

You can still save from game menu (I recommend doing so at least at the end of a session in Snow Plowing, due to the fact that you may, for example, buy an tool, want to exit the game but do not exit the garage and 'auto-save' does not appear - in which case the latter action will not be saved) or on white board in HUB[/b]

[h1]📲Contact us📠[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/dcaaf936b44aada734745d1cfc499ef7164959bf.jpg[/img]
[b]From now on, if you encounter a bug, you can immediately report it to us via the game by sending an additional save! (We also recommend that you put your e-mail address in the ‘write back’ field, which will allow us to fix your save if a bug is preventing you from continuing the game in some way🕵).
You can of course also report your ideas via this option🛠️
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/87b0110fd0346745bfcf889974ff130dc3f59eff.jpg[/img]

[h1]👨‍🔧Fixing minor errors👩‍🔧[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/802c1f95a04220ba7efbcd207081bf2efeebc1bc.jpg[/img]
[b]We have improved the save system. You will have to wait a while longer before entering the game for the first time, but this will reduce your save. Some players used to have 250 megabytes in their save folder, now it will be around 50 megabytes. Your saves should load faster.[/b]

❗️Remember - Snow Plowing is still in Early Access. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports❗️

notes.title: 🔎Snow Plowing Simulator - Early Access Sneak Peek!🔍
notes.content:
[h3]🥶Brrrr!🥶[/h3]

In less than 24 hours we will start our voyage in Early Access. What does it mean? We want to deliver you the best experience possible, remember it is a solodev project. From now on we are going to listen to you the community of Snow Plowing Simulator, to your feedback, opinions, and ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/5530a03d2717eeab7ae0f41856be2324b5b9182f.png[/img]

[b]Firstly we will answer probably the most important questions.[/b]


[h3][b][u]1. What's the price of the game?[/u][/b][/h3]

It's [b]15.99$[/b] with [b]a launch discount of a minimum of 5%[/b] as we have passed 2000 followers. Now is the time to go higher. 2400 = 10%! (however, the price in your country may vary, prices proposed by Steam)

[h3][b][u]2. What languages are in the game?[/u][/b][/h3]
Every language that you see on the Steam card of the game. If you can't find yours, write to us. Maybe we can add it later.

[h3][b][u]3. Will it have bundles with other games?[/u][/b][/h3]

Yes, quite a lot. The best to find them all is to type after the release on Steam "Snow Plowing"

[h3][b][u]4. What will I get in Early Access?[/u][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/7e59be39cdf44916aee103eb59917c7a6ece326c.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]  🏡21 properties plus 11 roads to clear snow
[*] 🏔️ Three difficulty levels
[*] ❄️5 different snow removal hand tools
[*] 🚜2 vehicles available - a pickup truck and a tractor, differing in operating speed and driving physics
[*] 🚗Vehicle accessories: 4 different types of tires, 2 plows
[*] 🍏 Items: 27 powerups differing in calorie content and the space they take up in your pockets, medicines, frostbite creams, a thermos, and 7 type of clothes.
[*]  🕵️12 NPCs who develop the story and help you unlock new equipment
[*] 🧹 10 Additional tasks
[*] 📒 The main storyline takes more than 12 hours, but afterward, you still play and chill in the game
[*] ⭐️ 21 Achievements
[*] ❤️ Fatigue sweat and tears of happiness from Artur, developer of the game
[/list]


[h3][b][u]5. Hardware requirements[/u][/b][/h3]

Cards with performance similar to RTX 2070 allow for smooth gaming at 60fps in HD. For weaker cards, it is possible to set significantly limited graphics settings, which should improve performance.

[h3][b][u]6. How will the game change through EA?[/u][/b][/h3]

Based on the fan feedback mostly
a) Gameplay improvements as the game and its community grows
b) More tools, vehicles, quests, items
c) More Achievements
d) New mechanics
e) More into the story

It mostly depends on you, if you like it, we can make it.

[h3][b][u]7. Will we have a launch stream?[/u][/b][/h3]
Yes. It will start on the day of release.


Remember if you want to write to us, let us know a problem you are having or an idea. It's best to do it on the Steam forum or our [url=https://discord.gg/sMBT77MDrU]discord[/url] channel where we are non-stop monitoring.

If you still haven't done it, wishlist the game and get the best possible discount on release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096030/Snow_Plowing_Simulator/

Have fun,
FreeMind

Btw. Check new game we have just announced. A funny online coop simulation/action game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers/

notes.title: Cold and survival mechanics
notes.content:
[h3]Today we celebrate Snowplow Mailbox Hockey Day![/h3]

The day is celebrated as a token of appreciation by the local community towards the hardworking snow plowers who clear the streets, roads, and sidewalks every year in winter. Remember to take down your mailbox :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/0eef14e7790d3c1ba30fba83906e8ef0cb8a0865.png[/img]

[b]Winter means one thing. COLD![/b] [u]Snow Plowing Simulator is not just a casual and fun game. In many cases, it's very realistic.[/u] How cold can affect you in the game, how to fight with effects of cold, and how to prevent it? Let's find 

[h3][b]Temperature[/b][/h3]
We are adapting to the current times. The weather is very volatile. Day, night, warmer, colder, light snowfall, heavier, blizzard etc. Watch this and relax a bit with this cozy and warming music.
[previewyoutube=T_LVfBZ_ZxU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Food[/b][/h3]
Warm or cold. We must eat. What can we eat? Cold meals, hot meals, lunch sets, breakfast sets, drinks, snacks, fruits, and more. Let's add stimulants like coffee or tea and medicines and we have plenty to choose from

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vOK1dkR.gif[/img]

Food increases our energy and prevents dehydration. Some can warm us up. Meals have more or less caloric content and depending on whether the food is healthy or less healthy the calories can disappear quickly or last for a long time. In short, we will stay full longer after a healthy dish than after a less healthy one.

[h3][b]Effects of temperature - warming up and freezing[/b][/h3]
When we go outside where the temperature is below zero. We quickly get cold. It's no different here. The longer we stand outside, the faster our temperature will drop. After a while, the screen will start to frost, we will start to shiver from the cold and it is then worth considering warming up.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SUnKDiC.gif[/img]

We warm up either by entering a room that is warm or, for example, by drinking hot coffee.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h5SsqIv.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Sickness - cough, fever, and medications[/b][/h3]
If we have kept our body cold for a long time then we will get sick. The disease is that we will be troubled by a persistent cough, in addition, our fever increases. The effects of the disease become more and more noticeable and visible with each passing moment.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NPADXSR.gif[/img]

To get rid of these we will need medication. We can order aspirin for fever and cough syrup from the store.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ibbUvsA.gif[/img]

Everything depends on the temperature and our outfit. If it is very cold and we are dressed up lightly it will be quite problematic to work. Like in real life. It's better to prevent getting sick than fight the consequences later with meds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IZCJXJn.gif[/img]

And that's all for now. Keep yourself warm and stay tuned for the next devlog
Snow Plowing Simulator team

notes.title: Devlog - Another milestone!
notes.content:
[h3]Another milestone!

Thank you all for your comments, ideas and help you give us in all our social media! Let's stick together and soon we can all start the [b]Great Snow Removal[/b]![/h3]

In line with your suggestions, we've already made [b]the first few changes for the better.[/b] But more on that... [u][b]First, a few screenshots:[/b][/u]

[i]When you catch a cold, you can use various medications.[/i]
Cough? Fever? Now you don't have to worry anymore - go to the store and buy medicine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/c9c7c696f5ac7ccbd389f318c67b148028bc9e5d.jpg[/img]

[i]Do you know this feeling when the courier finally arrives?[/i] ːsteamhappyː
Now some tools will be available only when they are delivered by a courier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/bf6fabfe0d32806655e98f9e8e2890118cbd3882.jpg[/img]

[i]Inventory, inventory! - where you were?[/i]
Remember that unhealthy food will add calories quickly, but they will wear out[b] just as quickly[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/c4de8dd7b37e085740e14555aa1ea9e4b73cfd9f.jpg[/img]

[i]Level one: SUCCESSFUL![/i]
Just clearing snow is not enough. It still needs to be done accurately and quickly! Then a[b] satisfied customer will definitely recommend you to someone new.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/64f22fb18a8232efe447039aa92e1a4072225f8a.jpg[/img]

And this is a short timelapse of our finished weather system taking into account [b]many factors and even daily temperature fluctuations[/b]. [u][b]We are especially proud of it![/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=BOEitS7soRc;full][/previewyoutube]

Once again,[b] thank you very much for your comments and suggestions![/b] Thanks to you, the store interface looks much better and more readable, and the changed service makes the game just [b]pure pleasure![/b] A moment more patience and you will all be able to play Snow Plowing Simulator - demo will be available really soon... ːsteamhappyː

We''ll be in touch...
[i]Snow Plowing Simulator Team[/i]
